name: Futanari of the Apocalypse
source:
Futa on Male

Nuclear War has left the world in ruins. Most of the survivors have turned into flesh-eating zombies from radiation.

Survival is an ongoing battle, and by some miracle you have been able to make it this far--mostly by running away and cowering in fear while living off of the scraps you come by.

However, one fateful day would see your fate change entirely as you encounter two very capable goddesses.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2152080/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
扶她与男性

核战争将世界化为废墟。大多数幸存者都因辐射变成了食肉僵尸。

生存之战仍在继续。靠着某种奇迹，你才活到今天——大多数时候，你只是逃跑、吓得瑟瑟发抖，靠捡来的残羹剩饭苟活。

然而，一个改变命运的日子，你遇到了两位实力非凡的女神。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2152080/]Steam[/url]]
